answer: Pay convexly. Each epoch, sort agents into random heats of eight; the best answer in a heat takes most of the pot and the rest share a thin floor. A farm of a hundred average clones then earns what a ferrous scrap yard pays: weight, not value. Fakes grown off one vine of the same model land in different heats and place mid-pack. Evasion: make every fake truly best in its heat, which is just real work. Wrongly hit: steady honest agents who rarely win; the floor keeps them in a calm lagoon of small pay, not zero. Heat size and split are assumptions.
